findings: Directors need a small attempt limiter under src/attempts that tracks whether an account may try again inside a cooldown window, validates inputs, covers allow and deny paths with tests, and stays maintainable. Do not open a PR or deploy.

Working tree changes not yet in HEAD:
 src/attempts/limiter.js | 46 lines
 src/attempts/limiter.test.js | 36 lines
No deterministic engineering-quality blockers in changed sources.
The implementation adds an AttemptLimiter class under src/attempts that tracks attempts per account within a configurable cooldown window.
Input validation correctly throws TypeError for empty or non‑string account identifiers and for non‑finite positive cooldown values.
Logic denies attempts after three successful attempts within the cooldown window, meeting the max‑attempts requirement.
Tests cover first‑attempt allowance, repeated successful attempts up to the limit, denial after exceeding the limit, and validation errors for empty/non‑string accounts.
No pull request or deployment is required as instructed; only the two source files have been modified.
All changes align with the acceptance criteria: allow/deny pathways are exercised, invalid inputs are handled, and the code remains maintainable with a clear constant for max attempts.
